sloka: एतान्निहत्यातिबलान् बहून् राक्षससत्तमान्।बाहुभ्यां सागरं तीर्त्वा लङ्घ्यतां गोष्पदं लघु ।। ६.९०.१५ ।।
transliteration: etānnihatyātibalān bahūn rākṣasasattamān।bāhubhyāṁ sāgaraṁ tīrtvā laṅghyatāṁ goṣpadaṁ laghu ।। 6.90.15 ।।

translations.english: "You have made short of many exceedingly mighty leaders of Rakshasas and swum the ocean. You cross this hoof mark of a cow without delay."
